Technical SEO.title: Google Publishes Guidance For Google-Agent Crawler
Technical SEO.summary: Google has published official guidance explaining how website owners and SEOs can identify legitimate Google-Agent crawler requests and prevent security systems from incorrectly blocking them. This is directly relevant for enterprise sites where WAFs and bot-mitigation tools may interfere with AI-agent crawling.

Technical SEO.title: Check Your Nov. 18 Rank Data Before Blaming The Core Update
Technical SEO.summary: A rank tracking tool received roughly a tenth of its normal volume of Google results for several hours during the November core update, with a sign-in page appearing among the blocked responses. Enterprise SEOs should audit their Nov. 18 rank data for tracking anomalies before attributing ranking shifts to the core update itself.

Technical SEO.title: Google AI Mode Dive Deeper Is Now Live
Technical SEO.summary: Google has launched the Dive Deeper feature in AI Mode, making links shown at the end of some AI responses more visually prominent with image thumbnails and a more clickable design. This change affects how source links appear in AI Mode results, with direct implications for organic click-through from AI answer surfaces.

Technical SEO.title: Google StarSearch, AIGC, Zero-History Discovery, Feed Ranking and More
Technical SEO.summary: A Google job listing for a Senior Software Engineer role on Discover Feed Recommendations references several internal projects including StarSearch, AIGC, and Zero-History Discovery, offering a rare signal of Google's near-term product roadmap for feed and discovery surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT Product Results May Now Be Influenced By OpenAI Partnerships
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: OpenAI quietly removed the disclaimer from its Shopping with ChatGPT Search help documentation that stated product results are selected independently and not influenced by any OpenAI partnerships. The revised language no longer guarantees editorial independence, raising important questions for brands relying on organic visibility in ChatGPT shopping surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Bing Reverting Naming AI Overviews Back To Copilot Search
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Microsoft is testing a revert of the AI Overviews branding in Bing Search back to the original Copilot Answers label, just months after renaming the feature. The branding instability may affect how enterprise teams track and report on Bing AI answer visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Business Hub offers a glimpse of a search console for AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: Digiday frames the ChatGPT Business Hub as an early Search Console equivalent for publishers, signaling a new layer of AI search visibility management that could become critical infrastructure for enterprise content teams. The hub also allows businesses to connect an ad account to promote across ChatGPT surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Why Building Trust Through Real People Stands the Test of Time in SEO and AI Search
AI Search / GEO.summary: The article argues that demonstrable expertise from real, named individuals is an increasingly important signal for visibility in both traditional search and AI-generated answer surfaces. This is directly relevant to GEO content strategy, particularly for travel and automotive brands looking to build authoritative AI citations.

AI Search / GEO.title: Does Ranking Still Earn the AI Citation? A UK Study of 7,836 AI Overview Citations
AI Search / GEO.summary: A UK-based study analyzed over 7,800 AI Overview citations to examine the relationship between traditional organic rankings and AI citation selection. The findings are directly actionable for GEO strategy, as they test whether ranking high in organic results is still a prerequisite for being cited in AI-generated answers.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: A data study tracks which domains are most frequently cited by major AI answer engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, providing a benchmark for enterprise teams building GEO strategies.

AI Search / GEO.title: Site exits Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, clicks barely move
AI Search / GEO.summary: A reported case study examines a site that was removed from Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, finding that organic clicks remained largely unchanged afterward. This challenges assumptions about the click value of AI Overview citations and has direct implications for enterprise GEO investment decisions.

AI Search / GEO.title: AI Citation Sources: Which Publishers AI Engines Name and Cite
AI Search / GEO.summary: 5WPR's State of AI Citations report examines which publishers and content types are most frequently named and cited by AI search engines, offering competitive intelligence for enterprise brands building authority for AI answer surfaces.
